name: Picsart Enterprise
description_en:
Picsart Enterprise provides creative editing APIs and embeddable editor SDKs for software products, marketing tools, ecommerce and web-to-print. It is an integration offering at picsart.io, separate from buying a consumer Picsart app subscription. APIs process images/video or generate content; editor SDK packages add configurable user-facing tools and content libraries.

It fits developers embedding a controlled creative workflow or automating image operations. Budget API credits and editor/content packages separately, protect credentials and validate the chosen endpoint’s request/output/failure behavior. A vendor SDK or code snippet is not a complete production integration, and headline cutout quality is not independent evidence.

它适合嵌入受控创作流程或自动处理图像的开发者。API点数与编辑器/内容套餐须分别预算，保护凭据，验证所选端点的请求/输出/失败行为。厂商SDK或代码片段不是完整生产集成，抠图质量宣传也不是独立证据。

sections.title_en: Pick API processing or an embedded editor
sections.title_zh: 选择API处理或嵌入编辑器
sections.en:
The [enterprise site](https://picsart.io/) presents image/video/GenAI APIs, print editors, marketing editors and white-label configuration. An ecommerce service could call background removal after upload; a print platform could embed an editor with its own fonts/layouts and export requirements. These are different integration and commercial choices. Consumer Picsart membership does not establish API credentials, SDK seats or licensed stock redistribution.

Some homepage items are explicitly Coming Soon, including selected brand-space, bulk and design-control entries. They are not counted as shipped functionality. The AI Hub also lists third-party providers/models, whose current availability and per-model conditions can change; their presence is not a license to use every model or content library at one fixed price.
sections.zh:
[企业站](https://picsart.io/)提供图像/视频/GenAI API、印刷和营销编辑器及白标配置。电商服务可上传后调去背景，印刷平台则可嵌入自有字体/布局及导出要求的编辑器，两者集成和商业选择不同。消费者会员不自动提供API凭据、SDK席位或图库再分发权。

首页部分品牌空间、批量及设计控制明确标Coming Soon，不计为已发布。AI Hub另列第三方提供商/模型，可用性和逐模型条件会变，出现名称不代表固定价格即可使用全部模型和图库。

sections.en:
The [Remove & Change Background reference](https://docs.picsart.io/reference/image-remove-background) documents POST to api.picsart.io/tools/1.0/removebg with X-Picsart-API-Key. Choose one source: binary image or image_url, leaving other source parameters empty; image_id is marked deprecated. The prose recommends upload-once reuse for repeated transformations, while its current ID field is deprecated, so verify the current upload/transaction reference before implementing that optimization.

output_type defaults to cutout and can be mask. PNG is default, with JPG/WEBP alternatives. Background options include color/image, blur, dimensions, fit/fill and optional centering; centering is not recommended for partially visible objects. A model parameter can pin an explicit model because the default may change. For example, a catalog pipeline should choose whether it needs a transparent cutout or a mask and preserve that choice in its downstream schema rather than blindly treating every 200 response as an interchangeable image.
sections.zh:
[Remove & Change Background参考](https://docs.picsart.io/reference/image-remove-background)列POST到api.picsart.io/tools/1.0/removebg，使用X-Picsart-API-Key。二进制image或image_url选一个，其他源参数留空，image_id标deprecated。文字建议重复转换先上传复用，但当前ID字段已弃用，实现前应核对现用upload/transaction引用，不能直接照旧优化。

output_type默认cutout，也可mask；格式默认PNG，另有JPG/WEBP。背景可设颜色/图片、模糊、尺寸、fit/fill及居中，但不建议对部分可见物体自动居中。model可固定模型，因为默认会变。例如目录流水线应明确需要透明抠图还是蒙版，并在下游契约保留选择，不能把所有200响应都当等价图片。

sections.title_zh: 输入构图影响抠图质量
sections.en:
The [supported-image guide](https://docs.picsart.io/reference/supported-image-types-for-remove-background) recommends a clear foreground, contrast, correct orientation and relatively plain background. Blurry edges stay problematic; groups, large foreground props, harsh shadows and reflections can confuse the separation. For cars, the guide says only the largest visible car is cut out. These limitations qualify marketing promises of flawless hair or jewelry edges.

Use representative single products, reflective goods, fine hair and difficult backgrounds in an acceptance set. Check alpha edges, holes, crop, scale and output format visually; measure error/rejection rates before committing a bulk catalog. The read endpoint lists JPG/PNG/WEBP/TIFF/BMP/MPO/MJPEG/HEIC inputs, but exact byte/pixel caps were not established. No asset or API request was submitted, so no accuracy, latency or throughput result is claimed.
sections.zh:
[输入建议](https://docs.picsart.io/reference/supported-image-types-for-remove-background)要求前景清晰、有对比、方向正确且背景较简单；模糊边缘仍困难，大群体、大道具、强阴影及反射会影响分割，汽车图只抠最大可见车辆。这些限制限定了完美发丝/珠宝边缘宣传。

验收集应覆盖单品、反光物、细发及困难背景，检查透明边缘、空洞、裁切、缩放和格式，批目录前测错误/拒绝率。端点列JPG/PNG/WEBP/TIFF/BMP/MPO/MJPEG/HEIC输入，但未建立准确字节/像素上限。未提交素材或API请求，不声称准确性、延迟或吞吐结果。

sections.title_en: Handle authentication, credits and provider overload separately
sections.title_zh: 认证、点数及提供商过载分别处理
sections.en:
The reference lists 401 authentication,402 payment,403 forbidden,413 size,415 media type,422 validation,429 rate limiting and 500/503 service errors, plus 529 model-provider overload. These are API contract possibilities, not failures observed in this research. An integration should inspect the actual status/body, correct invalid inputs or credentials and apply bounded retries appropriate to transient limits/provider failures; repeated bad-payment or validation requests do not become successful through retry.

Keep credentials confidential in the integration and avoid shipping them in public source. A provider model change or URL expiry can affect reproducibility; retain the selected operation/model and result ownership/retention requirements. Exact rate limits, retry headers, error billing, response/download lifetime and asynchronous behavior for other APIs require their own references. No token, key or account was created or used.
sections.zh:
参考列401认证、402付款、403禁止、413尺寸、415媒体类型、422验证、429限流及500/503服务错误，另有529模型提供商过载。这些是API契约可能，不是本文实际调用失败。集成应检查状态/响应，修正无效输入或凭据，对临时限制/提供商故障采用适当有界重试；无效付款或验证请求不因重复就成功。

应保密集成凭据，不把它们放进公开源码。模型变化或URL失效可影响复现，需保留操作/模型及结果权利/保留要求。具体限流、重试头、失败计费、响应/下载期限及其他API异步行为需各查文档。未创建或使用令牌、密钥或账户。

sections.title_en: API credits are separate from SDK packages
sections.en:
The [API pricing page](https://picsart.io/pricing/api/) lists five free credits, multiple keys, credit use across image/video/GenAI/variable-data APIs and pay-as-you-go with overdrafts, while describing separately free basic preview/upload/variable-description endpoints. Exact per-endpoint/model prices and current paid package amounts were not exposed in the read default view; overdrafts need an explicit spending arrangement rather than an assumption of unlimited free testing.

Embedded Photo Print/Static Ads editor offers start at $99/month with 1,000 included credits; Web-to-Print/Video Ads packages start at $299 with 10,000. Their trial lists 1,000 credits, not the API page’s five. Premium fonts/photos/templates/filters and custom development/exclusivity may cost extra; enterprise quotes and annual commitments are separate. These are vendor starting packages with exact currency/tax/usage terms to confirm, not a normalized per-image cost.
sections.zh:
[API价格页](https://picsart.io/pricing/api/)列5个免费点、多密钥、图像/视频/GenAI/变量内容共用点数及可透支随用随付，另把基础预览/上传/变量描述列为免费端点。实读默认视图未显示逐端点/模型价格及当前付费包金额；透支需明确预算安排，不能假定无限免费测试。

Photo Print/Static Ads嵌入编辑器$99/月起含1,000点，Web-to-Print/Video Ads $299起含10,000点，试用列1,000点，与API5点不同。高级字体/照片/模板/滤镜及定制/独占可另费，企业询价与年约独立。这是厂商起始套餐，币种/税费/使用细则需确认，不是统一单图成本。

sections.title_en: Enterprise integration rights and content obligations
sections.title_zh: 企业集成权及内容责任
sections.en:
The official terms link redirects to [Picsart Enterprise Terms](https://picsart.com/developer-guidelines/) dated November 4,2024. It permits integrating services into the developer’s own app for authorized end users while reserving Picsart IP and other product licenses. It requires credential confidentiality and an enforceable end-user agreement. It is a restricted proprietary integration grant, not an open-source platform license or permission to expose the developer tools themselves to unrelated third parties.

The content section retains user rights excluding embedded Licensed Content, but grants broad operation/improvement rights and restricts certain regulated/sensitive data. Privacy/DPA and third-party/AI conditions also apply. Subject to an order form, fees are prepaid, purchased services must be used within twelve months and refunds are limited by the stated exceptions. Those full agreements and contract-specific overrides were not audited. The exact external URL/read hash is preserved separately because the catalog’s main-source domain is picsart.io. No integration, end-user flow, security review or paid execution was performed.
sections.zh:
官方条款跳转至[2024年11月4日Picsart Enterprise Terms](https://picsart.com/developer-guidelines/)，允许把服务集成到开发者自有应用供获准最终用户使用，同时保留Picsart知识产权和其他产品许可，要求凭据保密及可执行最终用户协议。这是受限专有集成授权，不是平台开源，也不允许把开发工具本身暴露给无关第三方。

内容条款保留用户权利但排除嵌入的Licensed Content，另授广泛运营/改善权并限制某些受监管/敏感数据，还适用隐私/DPA及第三方/AI条件。在订单优先条件下费用预付，购买服务须12个月内使用，退款仅限规定例外。完整协议及合同覆盖未审计。因目录主来源域为picsart.io，实际外域URL/实读哈希单独保留。未执行集成、最终用户流程、安全审查或付费调用。
